sentences.text: The aforesaid order is quoted hereunder :-
"Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Shesh Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the respondent nos.6 and 7 and Sri Ratan Singh, learned AGA for the State.

The present writ petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the impugned first information report dated 17.12.2014 registered as Case Crime No. 213 of 2014, under Sections 409, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.c. & 13(2) Prevention of Corruption Act, Police Station Chetganj, District Varanasi and direct the respondents not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of the impugned first information report.
Submission of learned counsel for the petitioner

is that no offence is made out against the petitioner as no payment to the press has been made after financial year 2010-11; there is no specific allegation as to what amount has been misappropriated by the press of the petitioner; and that father of the petitioner who was proprietor of press died on 25.02.2018 and petitioner has only signed the document between 2009-10 due to illness of his father.

Per contra learned counsel for the informant-University and learned AGA submitted that first information report was filed after due inquiry in the matter and it was found that huge amount to the tune of Rs.5.68 crore has been misappropriated by the petitioner.

It was also pointed out that present FIR has been lodged by the Inspector,
EOW, Varanasi Sector, Varanasi after due inquiry.

We find that cognizable offence is made out against the petitioner and argument advanced by learned counsel for the petitioner in his defence cannot be considered for the purpose of quashing of the first information report.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.

However, we find that first information report is dated 17.12.2014 and as per learned AGA, investigation is still pending which clearly reflects sorry state of affair on the part of the investigating agency whereas fraud in respect of huge public money of university has been committed which involves officers of the university as well and Pramila Pandya And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: apparently the investigation is not proceeding with any effective progress.

Under such circumstances, Sri Ratan Singh, learned AGA is directed to seek report regarding status of investigation from respondent no.2, Police Commissioner, Police Commissionerate Varanasi in this regard as nine years have passed and investigation is virtually not proceeding.
The report shall be submitted on personal affidavit of respondent no.2.

Put up this case in the list of fresh cases on 20.04.2023 only for the purpose to consider the status of investigation as already noticed.
The petition stands dismissed in so far as petitioner is concerned.
Sri Shesh Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant-University has very gracefully accepted to remain present on the next date fixed."
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed for want of prosecution.
Interim order, if any, granted earlier, stands vacated.
